title: Tour Muscle Shoals Sound Studio
description: Walk into the low-key building at 3614 Jackson Highway where the Swampers and visiting artists recorded some enduring songs. A guided visit to Muscle Shoals Sound Studio connects the control room, instruments, and recording floor to the music made there. Listen before or after your tour and see how an ordinary room acquired an extraordinary sound.
teaser: See the Alabama studio behind a remarkable run of records.
goodToKnow: Before you go, confirm tour hours and standing/access requirements.
whyItMightDelightYou: The studio’s plain rooms make the collaborative work behind famous songs feel real.
